test_item:
For ECU verification scenarios, the system shall dynamically retrieve the CRL from the Distribution Point (CDP) URL(s) defined within the target certificate.
(no revocation list file is written to the storage partitions)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. The DUT has network access
3. An ECU certificate carrying a valid revocation distribution point is available
proc:
1. Confirm the content of /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store
er: 1. The adb shell ls -l /vendor/odm/etc/cert_store output lists no revocation list file written during verification
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-CertProvider-005 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
